title: The Midnight Case
verdict: Ronan Hayes was responsible for the disappearance of a student's solar-cell module.
intent: Ronan Hayes wanted to prevent a rival team from winning the regional prize.
The culprit needed delayed discovery so the object could pass the first search and be recovered later.
action_schema: Use role-specific access: the lab monitor locked the storage room after the final project check.
Remove a student's solar-cell module from its checked location.
Hide the item in a rolled poster tube.
Allow incomplete suspicion to fall on distractor suspects.
evidence_cues: a student's solar-cell module disappeared from a science fair storage room before judging.
The object was confirmed present before the relevant disturbance.
The disappearance occurred within a narrow time window because the room fan was unplugged to mask the solder smell.
The physical trace was resin drops beside the poster tubes.
The relevant tool or mechanism was a soldering iron with fresh resin.
The item could be concealed in a rolled poster tube.
The hiding place required insider knowledge because only the lab monitor knew the fan outlet was hidden behind the cabinet.
distractor_cues: a judge inspecting the poster tubes
A visible conflict is suspicious but insufficient without timing and mechanism.
A bulky object or nervous behavior is insufficient unless it explains the hidden container.
